answer: Identity bonds decay like shale weathering: each agent locks 60 POA, losing 5% of its value every epoch unless it keeps working. A vertex in the trust graph earns standing slowly, and a whisper of fake activity cannot rebuild a decayed bond overnight. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 60,000 POA, and idle bonds keep bleeding value. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full bond, so honest cost stays low while sybils pay again and again.
